policies.name: Opinions on Further Strengthening Plastic Pollution Control
policies.summary: Phases out non-degradable plastic bags in major cities and bans single-use plastic straws and stir-sticks in restaurants nationwide.

newsFeed.headline: Yangtze plastic flux drops a fifth as China expands sorting in coastal cities
newsFeed.summary: A multi-city study reported a measurable decline in plastic carried by the Yangtze, attributed to expanded waste-sorting and bag bans.

wooby.headline: China makes more plastic than any country — but is changing fast.
wooby.narrative: Wooby travels the East China Sea and sees more plastic than almost anywhere. China makes a lot of the world's plastic, and a lot of its waste. But China has also banned single-use plastic bags in big cities. Wooby is watching closely.
